text_block_list.text:
One day, on a day out with Sakura Bakushin 
O――

Sakura Bakushin O was looking at a stuffed 
Uma Musume doll―a prize for the crane 
game.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's the stuffed doll that's all the 
rage in my class!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, I must keep up with 
the class trends!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, now let's Bakushin this arm and 
try to get that stuffed doll!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! I'm going to get that stuffed 
doll with the power of Bakushin!

I can easily imagine that it would be 
impossible to get a stuffed doll by using 
"the power of Bakushin" as she says……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, what dependable words! You seem to be 
quite capable!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And, if you top it off with my support as 
class president――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Surely we'll be invincible! Trainer, let's 
do our best!
